about.title: Building homes, schools, and offices that last
about.lead: We are a collective of engineers, site managers, and craftsmen delivering structurally sound, beautifully finished spaces across Egypt.
about.approachTitle: Our approach is rooted in precision and accountability.
about.approachBody: We believe the best buildings are the ones that outlast their blueprints. By pairing rigorous structural engineering with careful site supervision, we deliver spaces that are as durable as they are livable. Whether you're building a family home or breaking ground on a new facility, we help you build something that lasts.

sectors.title: Engineering permanent solutions for six vital sectors
sectors.sub: From deep foundation pour to architectural final hand-over, we translate blueprints into enduring public and private spaces. Our specialized teams match rigorous engineering precision with structural utility.

residential.title: Residential Development
residential.body: Custom turnkey villas, smart luxury compounds, and architectural masterpieces designed for premium generational living.

commercial.title: Commercial & Administrative
commercial.body: Turnkey grade-A corporate towers, modern workspaces, and corporate headquarters built for collaboration and energy efficiency.

industrial.title: Industrial & Logistics
industrial.body: State-of-the-art warehouses, factories, and heavy infrastructure built to precise technical, logistics, and seismic load requirements.

companyProfile.title: About AmrAli Company
companyProfile.lead: AmrAli United Engineering has delivered residential, commercial, and industrial projects across Egypt for over a decade, combining structural precision with dependable site management.
points: Full-service engineering, from design to hand-over
companyProfile.body1: Every project starts with a detailed feasibility and structural review, so surprises get caught on paper instead of on site.
companyProfile.body2: We stay involved past hand-over with a maintenance window on every build, because a finished building is still our responsibility.
companyProfile.whyBody1: We control quality by keeping core trades in-house rather than fully subcontracting, so the crew on-site is the same crew accountable for the result.
companyProfile.whyBody2: Our project managers report progress weekly with photos and a schedule variance — no waiting until hand-over to find out where things stand.
companyProfile.whyBody3: Clients typically stay with us across multiple projects, which is the metric we actually optimize for.
